items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: Papa Booyah. It's a trumpet player. ... That trumpet player is a big ball.

ctx.x: You ever had many good bands in here?

You? Tell them that good bands are old. All these boys can play. That trumpet player playing that? But you ain't taller than you. Put them all together. You're gonna come with brothers. Papa Booyah. It's a trumpet player. Which one is the trumpet player? It's probably Booyah. Booyah. This is the trumpet player. Yeah. That's the trumpet player there. That trumpet player is a big ball. It's a big ball.
What do you think about those English bands? Good bands. What bands do you like over in England in particular?
